Contact GoldAlert

We welcome questions, data corrections, privacy requests and partnership enquiries. Please use the information below to get in touch.

Publisher: GoldAlert

Email: onlineadmin00@gmail.com

We aim to respond to all genuine messages within 2 business days. Please include the page URL and a clear description of your inquiry when writing to us.

When to Contact Us

  • Data errors: If you spot a price, ratio or signal that appears incorrect, please send us the page URL, the incorrect value, and what you believe the correct value should be.
  • Content corrections: For factual errors in our articles or educational content, include a link to a reliable source supporting the correction.
  • Privacy requests: To request information about data we hold, or to request deletion under applicable privacy laws, email us with "Privacy Request" in the subject line.
  • Widget or embed issues: If the embeddable gold price widget is not displaying correctly on your site, describe your browser, device, and the URL where it is embedded.
  • Partnership enquiries: For content partnerships, data licensing, or advertising enquiries, email us with "Partnership" in the subject line.

What We Cannot Help With

GoldAlert does not provide individualized investment advice, brokerage services, or financial planning. We cannot recommend when to buy or sell any asset. For investment decisions, please consult a licensed financial advisor.
